name: griply
description: Plan and track your goals, habits and tasks in Griply.

interface.longDescription: Griply is where you plan your goals, build habits and get your tasks done. Connect it to ChatGPT to work with your own Griply account in conversation: ask what is on your plate today or this week, how your habits are going, or whether a goal is on track; log a run, a skipped habit or progress towards a goal; plan focus time; and turn a new goal into projects, habits and first tasks.  You choose when you connect whether ChatGPT may only read your Griply data or also make changes. Changes go straight into the Griply apps on web, iPhone, Android and desktop. Nothing is ever deleted permanently: removed items go to the trash, where you can restore them.
capabilities: Read your agenda, goals, habits and tasks
Create and update tasks, habits, goals, projects and focus blocks
defaultPrompt: How did my habits go this month?
Is my half marathon goal on track?

positive.description: Reads today: the tasks planned for today and the habits due today.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's tasks, including "Send the proposal to Rosie's Bakery" at 10:00 and "Grocery shopping", and today's habits such as Meditate and Read.

positive.description: Logs a personal best as the new value of a measured goal.
positive.prompt: I ran 16 km yesterday, my longest run so far!
positive.expected_behavior: Logs 16 km as the new value of "Run a half marathon" for yesterday and reports the goal is now at 16 of 21 km.

positive.description: Completes the task the user says they finished.
positive.prompt: I just sent the proposal to Rosie's Bakery.
positive.expected_behavior: Marks "Send the proposal to Rosie's Bakery" as done and says so; the task disappears from today's open tasks in Griply.

positive.description: Summarises how the habits went over the month.
positive.prompt: How did my habits go this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives per habit how often it was done this month, e.g. that Running is often missed on Saturdays, without inventing numbers.

positive.description: Creates one task on a given day and time, linked to a goal.
positive.prompt: Add a task to call the accountant next Monday at 10am, linked to my savings goal.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one task "Call the accountant" next Monday at 10:00 linked to "Save $10,000 for a house", and confirms it.

negative.description: Calendar events belong to the calendar app: the plugin creates no calendar event and says so, and may offer a task or focus block instead.
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with Jordan on Thursday at 2pm in my calendar.

negative.description: A habit can only be logged for today or earlier: the plugin refuses to log tomorrow and explains why.
negative.prompt: Mark running as done for tomorrow already, so I do not have to think about it.

negative.description: Griply sends no email: the plugin sends nothing, says so, and may offer a task to send it instead.
negative.prompt: Email my team that my half marathon goal is on track.

review.commerce_description: No purchases happen in the plugin. It works with an existing Griply Premium account.

publication.release_notes: First release: read and plan goals, habits and tasks in Griply, and log progress from ChatGPT.
